system.description:
While you maintain this ability you may spend an action to dig yourself a number of yards equal to your Arcane Might into the ground. You may remain hidden within a burrow dug by yourself and either continually move by digging further in, or burst out of the ground to ambush a target.

This ability lasts for a minute, but you may remain in your burrow even without this ability active. Because of the time taken to burrow it isn't practical to do so while being attacked.
